navaid.name: USCGC Tackle
navaid.description: The 65-foot small harbor tugs are multi-mission cutters. Their primary missions are domestic ice breaking, port security, search and rescue, and law enforcement operations on rivers and inland areas.

navaid.name: USCGC Thunder Bay
navaid.description: The 140-foot Bay-class cutters are single-screw tugs used primarily for domestic ice breaking duties. These use a low pressure-air hull lubrication or bubbler system that forces air and water between the hull and ice.
